apupiwe: en mara sin nagu beya. wan sin tapi.
intended: Mara saw the door. She closed it.

apupiwe: en mara sin ibe ladon. wan sin alun.
intended: Mara had a cup. She broke it.

apupiwe: lowu le siten pasu. wan le binla.
intended: The man is cooking food. He is boiling it.

apupiwe: lowu sin nagu tale. wan sin bamo.
intended: The man saw the car. He stopped (it, or himself).

apupiwe: futa sin kobi lutu. tiwu fe sin kobi.
intended: The woman moved a stone. The child moved one too.

apupiwe: totu sin unda tiwu. yi sin unda.
intended: The dog woke the child. The child woke up.

apupiwe: en mara sin yidu ingo. wan sin benbi.
intended: Mara took the book. She opened it.
